stb_vorbis — Ogg Vorbis decoder v1.22 (public domain, see header).
Pinned: master as of 2026-09-16 (stb_vorbis.c, 192790 bytes).

Usage: the implementation is compiled once in
Engine/Audio/src/OggVorbisImpl.cpp (warning-lenient TU);
Engine/Audio/src/AudioDecoder.cpp includes it with
STB_VORBIS_HEADER_ONLY for the declarations. It backs OGG decoding
because miniaudio 0.11.25's bundled vorbis fork rejects known-good
Vorbis files (verified: stock stb_vorbis v1.22 opens them).
